attributes.title: Presentation

lesson.concept: One click can express one thought
lesson.why: Gates divide a score into semantic advances. Parallel work and small offsets let related pieces appear together rather than making the presenter click once per element.
lesson.experiment: Advance a gate, reverse, and advance again. Check that related elements form one beat and that already revealed content remains coherent.
lesson.pitfall: Replacing gates with timeouts divorces the presenter from the score and makes pause or reverse unreliable.
lesson.combine: Combine with slides for section changes and build-order for named dependencies inside each beat.
